params._token: The token's address (must be a registered token).

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the current owner to relinquish control of the contract.

params._fee: The fee amount to forward on to the RewardVault.
params._traderFrom: The address of the trader to decrement the balance of.
params._traderTo: The address of the trader to increment the balance of.
params._value: The number of tokens to decrement the balance by (in the        token's smallest unit).

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the current owner to transfer control of the contract to a newOwner.

params._newOwner: The address to transfer ownership to.

params._newBrokerVerifierContract: the address of the new broker verifier contract

params._newSettlementContract: the address of the new settlement contract

params._newRewardVaultContract: the address of the new reward vault contract

params._value: The amount to withdraw in the token's smallest unit.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposits ETH or an ERC20 token into the contract.

renounceOwnership().notice: Renouncing to ownership will leave the contract without an owner. It will not be possible to call the functions with the `onlyOwner` modifier anymore.

signalBackupWithdraw(address).notice: A trader can withdraw without needing a broker signature if they first call `signalBackupWithdraw` for the token they want to withdraw. The trader can only withdraw the particular token once for each call to this function. Traders can signal the intent to withdraw multiple tokens. Once this function is called, brokers will not sign order-opens for the trader until the trader has withdrawn, guaranteeing that they won't have orders open for the particular token.

transferBalanceWithFee(address,address,a.notice: Transfer a token value from one trader to another, transferring a fee to the RewardVault. Can only be called by the RenExSettlement contract.

updateBrokerVerifierContract(address).notice: Allows the owner of the contract to update the address of the RenExBrokerVerifier contract.

updateRenExSettlementContract(address).notice: Allows the owner of the contract to update the address of the RenExSettlement contract.

updateRewardVaultContract(address).notice: Allows the owner of the contract to update the address of the DarknodeRewardVault contract.

withdraw(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Withdraws ETH or an ERC20 token from the contract. A broker signature is required to guarantee that the trader has a sufficient balance after accounting for open orders. As a trustless backup, traders can withdraw 48 hours after calling `signalBackupWithdraw`.
